automation.subtitle: Rules that act automatically on conversations

csat.title: Send a message after closing the conversation

desc.autoAssignOn: When conversation is created → Assign to {{name}}
desc.autoAssignOff: When conversation is created → Assign to selected agent (disabled)
desc.welcomeSchedule: When conversation is created → Send message based on business hours schedule (2 messages)
desc.welcomeOff: When conversation is created → Send a fixed auto-reply (disabled)
desc.csatOff: When conversation is resolved → Send a message (disabled)
desc.keywordRoutingOff: When message contains chosen keywords → Assign to selected team (disabled)
desc.contractExpiredSingle: When a maintenance contract expires → One message{{suffix}}
desc.contractExpiredRepeatOnly: When a maintenance contract expires → Reply to every message
desc.contractExpiredOff: When a customer's maintenance contract passes its end date without renewal → An automated message is sent once (disabled)
desc.ratingOn: When a conversation is resolved → A star rating for issue resolution + a star rating for the support agent + an optional text comment are sent
desc.ratingOff: When a conversation is resolved → Star rating for issue resolution and support (disabled)

auto_assign.title: Auto-assign new WhatsApp conversations
auto_assign.enableDesc: When a new conversation is created, assign it immediately

welcome.title: Send welcome message
welcome.enableDesc: Send a fixed reply automatically to every new conversation
welcome.messageLabel: Welcome message sent to the customer
welcome.messageHint: This exact text is sent automatically as soon as a new conversation is opened.
welcome.placeholder: Thanks for reaching out! One of our support representatives will get back to you shortly.

csat.title: Send a message after closing the conversation
csat.enableDesc: Send a message to the customer right after the conversation is closed
csat.messageLabel: Message sent to the customer after the conversation is closed
csat.messageHint: This exact text is sent automatically the moment an agent resolves the conversation.
csat.placeholder: Thanks for reaching out! We hope we were able to help you today 🙏

keyword_routing.title: Route conversations by keyword
keyword_routing.enableDesc: When a customer message matches any of the keywords, move the conversation to the selected team

contract_expired.title: Maintenance Contract Expired
contract_expired.enableDesc: When a customer's maintenance contract passes its end date without renewal, send them this message automatically once per contract (enabling/disabling the reply-to-every-message option is available separately below)
contract_expired.messageHint: This same text is sent once per contract (option above), and also with every message the customer sends afterwards if you enable the "Reply to every message" option below.
contract_expired.placeholder: Dear customer, your maintenance contract has expired. To renew and ensure continued service, please get in touch with us 🙏
contract_expired.repeatToggleLabel: Reply with the same message to every message afterwards
contract_expired.repeatToggleDesc: If enabled, the same text will be sent to the customer with every message they send after the contract expires (not just once) — until the contract is renewed or this option is turned off

rating.title: Post-Resolve Rating
rating.enableDesc: When a conversation is resolved, send the customer a star rating for issue resolution + a star rating for the support agent + an optional text comment
rating.messagesHint: If you leave any of these fields empty, the customer will receive the default text shown as a placeholder inside it.
rating.issueMessagePlaceholder: Please rate your experience with us — rate how well we resolved your issue and rate the agent, and feel free to leave a comment 👇

rating.feedbackMessagePlaceholder: If you'd like to leave any comment or feedback to help us improve, write it now. Or tap "Skip" if you don't want to add a comment
